disclosures.name: TestReflectFuncOf
disclosures.reason: A MEASUREMENT AID, not a bankable exclusion. TestReflectFuncOf does not diverge -- it never finishes inside the package deadline, so the host is held until it is killed and every test after it alphabetically is lost with it (measured at db1bd885a2 on windows: 28 Go verdicts, 14 absent -- this test and the 13 after it). The cost is our own: the test calls mkfunc 200,000 times (two goroutines x 100,000, both naming "A"+i), which is 100,000 DISTINCT reflect.StructOf types, and every one is minted through Reflection.Emit (GoStructSynthesis.mint -> RuntimeTypeBuilder.CreateTypeNoLock) under the synthesis lock. dotnet-stack at 18.1 and 19.1 minutes shows the two goroutines SWAPPING roles -- one inside CreateTypeNoLock, the other in Monitor.Enter on that lock -- with 1,471 s of host CPU by 18.9 minutes: progress, not a deadlock; a throughput wall. Under the owner's ruling #1 a Go=pass / C#=hang that our own cost causes is a FEATURE GAP, so this entry does NOT make the row bankable: it withdraws the test from both sides by name only so the 13 verdicts behind it can be measured. LIFTED when a cheaper StructOf mint lands (the reflect cost item, option (b) of the 2026-09-26 sizing) or the test finishes inside its deadline; remove the entry in that change.
